mutants.why: PublishSellerWorkspace no longer pg_notifies, so no serve process's subscriber ever receives the seller workspace change.
The hub accepts a seller workspace change but never queues it for the store's subscribers.
Inbox signals are matched on the account alone, so a BUYER signal also reaches the same account's STORE stream.
Inbox signals are matched on the account alone, so the worker's BUYER inbox write also wakes the same account's STORE stream.
The per-account stream cap is never enforced, so an account can open unlimited streams.
Module.Watch no longer rejects the stream that exceeds MaxStreamsPerAccount.
The intent worker writes the inbox row but never pg_notifies in its transaction, so a subscriber on another process gets no signal.
Every processed intent signals the inbox stream, even ones that wrote no inbox row.
The worker path's pg_notify is gone, so the recipient's LISTEN-fed stream gets no inbox signal.
A seller workspace notification received on the LISTEN connection is not fanned out to the store's subscribers.
After the LISTEN connection is re-established, local subscribers are not told to re-read, so notifies lost during the outage stay lost.
A terminated LISTEN backend is reopened but subscribers get no re-read signal.
When Run ends, open streams are not closed, so server Shutdown waits on them until its timeout.
The notify runs on a separate pool connection instead of the caller's transaction, so a rolled-back change is still signalled.
